thread:
Alex M: Quick sync — where are we on the kernel "merge garden" items for this sprint? Specifically: kernel PR, continuous batching flag rollout, and KV warmup changes. Who's owning what and any blockers?
Samira R: I own the kernel PR: https://github.com/redwood/inference/pull/4987. Targeting merge EOD tomorrow, currently bisecting a perf regression at seq_len=1024.
Joel T: FYI infra needs a canary slot for kernel+batch combo. @infra-bot can you reserve a canary and post window?
infra-bot: Canary reserved: canary-17. Start window: 2026-03-21 02:00 UTC. Results will be posted to the thread when complete.
Leah P: Regress repro steps I used: 
```
./tools/repro.sh --model rwd-q4 --seq 1024 --device 16GB --runs 10
# captures p50/p95/p99 and flamegraphs to /tmp/repro-*.tar.gz
```
Observed +12% p99 on 16GB after the kernel path change.
Samira R: Thanks @Leah — that's the new attention path I landed in the branch. Bisect suggests scheduler tweak as likely culprit, bisecting now. Assigning to me + @Carla S for review.
Carla S: I can review tomorrow morning. Ping me once bisect narrows to a single commit; try to include a small repro in the PR description.
Frank N: Heads up — the Q4 quantized variant needs KV cache warmup hooks updated. I can own the KV hook change but it depends on kernel merge first.
Alex M: Ownership summary for clarity: kernel PR = Samira R; KV warmup hooks = Frank N; infra canary = Joel T. Dependency chain: kernel merge -> infra canary -> KV changes -> batch rollout.
Joel T: Can do canary once Samira posts merge commit. Also need a canary smoke script — @Leah can you paste the smoke script you used?
Leah P: Smoke script (simple):
```
# minimal smoke run for canary
python -m smoke_runner --endpoint http://canary-17:8080 --model rwd-base --batch-size 8 --seq 256 --requests 200
# collect perf: /var/log/smoke/canary-17-*.json
```
infra-bot: Canary smoke run completed at 12:34 UTC. Smoke passed, but observed p99 increase of ~8% during test window. Logs: https://logs.internal/redwood/canary-17/2026-03-21
Samira R: I pushed a candidate fix to the kernel PR (new scheduler heuristics). Local runs show p99 back to baseline. PR updated: https://github.com/redwood/inference/pull/4987. Requesting @Carla S review + @Alex M approval for merge window.
Carla S: Reviewing now — a couple of minor nits but nothing blocking. Left inline comments on the scheduler module.
Alex M: If Carla + Joel are good, we can merge during the low-traffic window tomorrow. @release-bot please schedule merge window 2026-03-21 04:00 UTC.
release-bot: Merge window scheduled for 2026-03-21 04:00 UTC. Will attempt auto-merge if CI green.
Samira R: Thanks. I'll also add a temporary runtime flag to toggle continuous batching off if we see p99 regressions post-merge (feature flag: batching.toggle_continuous).
Frank N: After kernel lands I'll rebase the KV warmup PR and tag for review. ETA: ~2 business days post-merge.
Alex M: Great. Milestone I'll track on the sprint board: kernel merge -> canary (kernel-only) -> canary (kernel+Q4) -> KV PR -> batch rollout. I'll ping owners if dates slip.
Leah P: Quick Q: do we want the Q4 quantized model in the first canary? That might be noisy. Suggest run kernel-only first, then kernel+Q4 if things look clean.
Joel T: Agree — run kernel-only first, then kernel+Q4. We'll allocate two separate canary manifests to isolate noise.
Samira R: ACK. I'll prepare two canary manifests and post them here before merge.
Carla S: Done reviewing — approved once CI passes.
Alex M: Closing this async check-in — I'll post updates here as we hit merge/canary milestones. Thanks team :calendar:
